objective: Validate promoted MCPGit binary packages by installing a disposable instance in GitHub Actions and black-box smoking HTTP, MCP, and Website Skills without compiling source or mutating business data.
boundaries: This binary release repository owns the hosted workflow. MCPGit source compilation remains local. The workflow follows offline-latest.json, creates one uniquely named disposable container and volume, uploads sanitized evidence, and cleans them on every outcome.
validation: client-only service_interface_smoke.py against an actual MCPGit process
workflow contract test proves install precedes smoke and contains no cargo build
